subject: Geografia
description_pt: Aplicar princípios de localização e posição de objetos (referenciais espaciais, como frente e atrás, esquerda e direita, em cima e embaixo, dentro e fora) por meio de representações espaciais da sala de aula e da escola.

components.description_pt: Aplicar termos de referência espacial para descrever posições de objetos
components.description_en: Apply spatial reference terms (front/back, left/right, above/below, inside/outside) to describe object positions
components.cc_component_description: Describe the position or motion of an object using a specified reference frame and unit system

components.description_pt: Localizar objetos dentro de uma representação espacial da sala usando referências posicionais
components.description_en: Locate objects within a spatial representation of the classroom using positional references
components.cc_component_description: Explain how maps represent the spatial arrangement of Earth's surface features

components.description_pt: Representar a posição de objetos no ambiente escolar usando pontos de referência espacial
components.description_en: Represent the position of objects in the school environment using spatial reference points
components.cc_component_description: Describe the position or motion of an object using a specified reference frame and unit system

cc_matches.description: All positions of objects and the directions of forces and motions must be described in an arbitrarily chosen reference frame and arbitrarily chosen units of size. In order to share information with other people, these choices must also be shared.
Maps show where things are located. One can map the shapes and kinds of land and water in any area.
